visualCharacteristics.structure: vertical list: date eyebrow + H3 title link + right arrow
visualCharacteristics.description: Single-column stack of text items in a narrow column; small grey-black date, dark-blue (#003b71) medium-weight H3 title, blue right-arrow aligned bottom-right of each item; whole item linked; generous vertical spacing between items.

contentPattern.structure: Cards (no images): one cell per row; date paragraph + H3 title wrapped in a link. Typically 3 items per block instance. Decorative inline icons are dropped

reuseGuidance: Use for text-only lists of dated, linked items (latest news, press releases). For linked tiles with images use cards-tile; for a single photo-background feature use cards-feature.
